dedupe_keys.name: historic earthquakes in the igad region

description: Historic Earthquakes in the IGAD Region is a hazard data set listed in ICPAC Geoportal (IGAD Climate Prediction and Applications Centre), a regional geoportal (GeoNode), published or maintained by ICPAC. Given the Great Rift Valley runs through the IGAD region, tectonic activity associated with the Great East African Rift System produces earthquakes in the Rift Valley and adjacent highlands. Vulnerability to earthquakes is significant due to lack of consideration of seismic risk in land use planning and poor building standards. Coverage: Africa (the listing does not name one country). The portal files it under the publisher ICPAC. The portal shows 2013-03-21 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (data set page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-icpac-portal.
